description: IBCS variance heatmap. Service category x year grid coloured by Actual-vs-Plan % variance, green (under plan) -> grey (on plan) -> red (over plan). Single diverging scale, no rainbow. Page 3 (Budget vs Actual). Deneb dataset fields required: service_category_1, year, scenario, amount. NOT PUBLISHED for the City of Vancouver dataset: no fiscal year carries both an Actual and a Plan (AC=2023-25, PL=2026 never overlap), so this renders blank or as a 3yr-vs-1yr artifact here; kept for a source that has same-period AC+PL. See 09-yoy-plan-vs-actual for the honest year-over-year comparison this data supports.

title.text: Variance heatmap: which programs drift from plan, and when
title.subtitle: Actual vs Plan %  ·  green = under plan  ·  red = over plan  ·  grey = on plan
